report.summary: The requested logs were retrieved. The pod in app-102 is inventory-service-7ff7d5959f-pw9m2 (phase Running), owned by ReplicaSet inventory-service-7ff7d5959f. Two log paths had to be used: the container-log API returned only the promtail sidecar's own startup output, because the inventory-service container (python:3.9-slim) writes its application log to the file /var/log/inventory.log and emitted 0 lines to stdout; the actual inventory-service log lines came from Loki (labels job=inventory-service, namespace=app-102, pod_name=inventory-service-7ff7d5959f-pw9m2, filename=/var/log/inventory.log), 8 lines between 2026-11-21T05:10:46.820603Z and 2026-11-21T05:11:19.408623Z. Content is normal operational output (order processed, stock updated, item checked, reconciliation of 127 items, periodic 'Inventory check completed - all systems operational') plus one WARN: 'Low stock warning for ITEM-9999 - current level: 5 units'. The 8 returned lines contain no ERROR/FATAL entry, the container is ready with restartCount 0, and namespace events show the Deployment inventory-service scaling its ReplicaSet from 0 to 1 at 05:10:44Z followed by normal Created/Started events, so the pod is young (started 2026-11-21T05:10:44Z) and the log history is correspondingly short; this is a log retrieval result, not a health certification.

The only non-INFO line in the returned inventory-service logs is level=WARN at 2026-11-21T05:10:48.377785Z: "Low stock warning for ITEM-9999 - current level: 5 units".

Events in app-102 (timestamps 2026-11-21T05:10:43Z to 05:10:46Z) show Deployment inventory-service reason ScalingReplicaSet "Scaled up replica set inventory-service-7ff7d5959f from 0 to 1" at 05:10:44Z, ReplicaSet inventory-service-7ff7d5959f SuccessfulCreate "Created pod: inventory-service-7ff7d5959f-pw9m2", and for that pod Scheduled, Pulled (python:3.9-slim already present), Created and Started; no Failed, BackOff, Killing or Evicted events appear in the returned set.

No evidence of a crash or application error was seen for this pod: restartCount=0 with empty lastState, no previous container instance existed, and the 8 returned application log lines contain no ERROR/FATAL entry (one WARN about low stock of ITEM-9999 only).

Rejected: the empty inventory-service container-log stream is not evidence of a failing or silent application; the promtail sidecar shows the application writes to /var/log/inventory.log (target added, tail started, file seeked at Offset:0), and Loki holds 8 matching lines from that path with 10-second-cadence INFO activity up to 05:11:19Z.
